## Invitations

The outreach programme issued 2316 invitations during the reporting period. A total of 777 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 33.5 per cent. This result provides the main measure of engagement for the invitation activity and will support routine monitoring of participation.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. The current result should therefore be considered alongside the normal seasonal pattern when reviewing outreach performance and planning future activity. Continued monitoring will help identify whether participation follows this pattern over time.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 1980 were sent with an SMS. A reminder message was also received by 1980 people. These contact figures record the use of text messaging alongside the invitation process and provide a clear basis for reviewing contact arrangements.

The invitation and reminder activity should continue to be recorded consistently so that attendance can be assessed against the contact approach. This will help inform future outreach planning and reporting.

Prepared by G. Evans.
